mostWorthwhile.text: Building the portal vessel was most worthwhile: its picture and explanation distinguish the two capillary beds from ordinary venous return and show why the liver encounters absorbed nutrients first.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the explicitly named portal-vessel slot was straightforward but offered little new information on its own.

surprise.text: I expected to connect the liver's exit directly to the digestive tube, but the feedback instead joined the tube to the body first. The final picture also clarified that some nutrients remain in the departing blood.

arbitrary.text: The required order for joining the digestive tube to the body before adding hepatic venous return was not obvious to me, although the feedback made the next step clear.

continue.text: I would continue: tracing the portal route and seeing where nutrients go made the construction useful for understanding how systems connect.
